assessments.reasoning: The Go Authors' go1.23.0 tag resolves to 6885bad7dd86880be6929c02085e5c7a67ff2887. This exact publisher resource is the corresponding tool documentation from that release. The fresh full-response digest binds the captured publisher file at the immutable release commit. The workspace help directly specifies precedence and the purpose of overriding conflicts among workspace module replacements. A go.work replacement is an override in the Go command's workspace context, distinct from Go source package import grammar. The Go project's go command operates in workspace mode and reads both the applicable go.work replacement and a conflicting module go.mod replacement. The claim describes documented workspace precedence, without specifying which replacement applies to every path/version pattern or the outcome in single-module mode. The workspace statement does not govern an invocation with no active go.work or establish the match of a replacement for arbitrary path/version keys.
